 Coram : V. K. Jadhav, J.
 Dated : 5 th September, 2019
 Per Court:-
 1.

The applicant is seeking bail in connection with crime No. 195 of  2019 registered with Pachod police station, District Aurangabad for the  offences punishable under Section 59 of Food, Safety and Standards  Act and under Section 188, 273, 328 of I.P.C.
His application bearing  Criminal Bail application No. 1448 of 2019 with similar prayer came to  be rejected by the learned I/c
Additional Sessions Judge (District Judge-  11), Aurangabad vide order dated 18.07.2019.

2. Heard both sides.
 3.

On going through the allegations made in the complaint and on Santosh S/O. Keshavrao Lawate vs The State Of Maharashtra on 5 September, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185118626/
1  perusal of investigation papers, it appears that the applicant caught  red-handed alongwith contraband articles on 20.6.2019.

It further appears that so far as the present applicant is ::: Uploaded on - 05/09/2019 ::: Downloaded on - 06/09/2019 05:33:5  ba954.19  -2-  concerned, the investigation is over for all practical purpose and the  only formality of filing charge sheet is remained.
The applicant has a  fixed place of residence at Vishrantinagar, Mukundwadi Railway Station  area, Aurangabad.
Learned A.P.P. has also verified the same through  the investigating officer.
Thus, considering the entire aspects of the  case I am inclined to grant bail to applicant on certain conditions.
Hence the following order:-
ORDER  I.
Application is hereby allowed.

II. The applicant Santosh Keshavrao Lawate, in connection with crime No. 195 of 2019 registered with Pachod police station, District Aurangabad for the offences punishable under Section 59 of Food, Safety and Standards Act and under Section 188, 273, 328 of I.P.C. be released on bail on furnishing personal bond of Rs.15,000/- with one surety of the like amount on following conditions:-
a) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence in any manner.
b) The applicant shall attend the concerned police station once in a week i.e. on every Sunday between 8.00 a.m. to 11.00 a.m. till filing of charge sheet.
III. Application is disposed of.

( V. K. JADHAV, J.)
